items.text:
This game is on the cusp of being fun and interesting but poorly tutorialized and riddled with baffling, hostile design decisions. After a painful hour of struggling through things to salvage my first ship, I returned home and took a gig. This gig inexplicably expired after 45 seconds, which I guess is okay, because it tried to send me to a place I couldn't find on the map and had no idea how to locate. That basic dynamic describes the whole experience. Unless you're willing to spend many (unfun, counterintuitive) hours fighting to figure out how to interact with the world, you won't get anywhere.

This game is like standing at a window and looking at a bunch of great ideas and interesting systems, only they're just out of reach and you'll never get to enjoy them.

I would pay big money for a space sim that achieved a happy medium between "literally pounding nails into your ♥♥♥♥ levels of confusion and difficulty" and "arcade shooter on a 2d plain". This isn't that, but maybe one day someone will make a game with similar aspirations that feels both immersive and friendly
items.text_zh:
这款游戏正处在好玩又有趣的边缘，但教程做得很差，还充斥着令人费解、充满敌意的设计决定。在痛苦地挣扎了一个小时、想尽办法抢救我的第一艘船之后，我回到家里接了一个活儿。这个活儿莫名其妙地在45秒后就过期了，我猜这也没关系，因为它试图把我送到一个我在地图上找不到、也完全不知道该怎么定位的地方。这个基本动态描述了整个体验。除非你愿意花很多（不好玩、反直觉的）小时去拼命弄明白如何与这个世界互动，否则你哪儿也去不了。

这款游戏就像站在窗前，看着一堆很棒的点子和有趣的系统，只不过它们就是够不着，而你永远也无法享受它们。

我愿意花大钱买一款能在“字面意义上把钉子钉进你♥♥♥♥般的困惑与难度”和“2D平面街机射击游戏”之间取得理想平衡的太空模拟游戏。这款不是那样，但也许有一天会有人做出一款有着类似抱负、既沉浸又友好的游戏。
